chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Janabah is disliked when the sun turns yellow and when it rises while it is yellow.

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةُ: the state of ritual impurity caused by sexual intercourse
key_terms.يُكْرَهُ: is considered disliked or discouraged in legal usage

ai.seo_question: At what times is janabah considered disliked according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a karahah ruling regarding janabah at specific times connected to the sun’s yellow appearance. It indicates a disliked time for sexual intercourse that results in janabah, within the etiquette-related rulings of ritual purity and marital conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4409 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), said:
"It is disliked to engage in janabah (ritual impurity due to sexual intercourse) when the sun is turning yellow and when it rises while it is yellow."
